excerpt.zh: 由于重大的记录错误，[Root.GetName]部分区域的基础设施维护与住宅服务已趋于落后。人们正居住在较为恶劣的环境之中，似乎已忍不了太久了。要修复这些问题则会耗费我们的时间与精力。
excerpt.en: Due to a major clerical error parts of [Root.GetName] has fallen behind in infrastructure maintenance and accommodation services. The people live in rather bleak conditions and will not tolerate it for long. Remedying these problems will cost us time and effor

texts.zh: 由于重大的记录错误，[Root.GetName]部分区域的基础设施维护与住宅服务已趋于落后。人们正居住在较为恶劣的环境之中，似乎已忍不了太久了。要修复这些问题则会耗费我们的时间与精力。
texts.en: Due to a major clerical error parts of [Root.GetName] has fallen behind in infrastructure maintenance and accommodation services. The people live in rather bleak conditions and will not tolerate it for long. Remedying these problems will cost us time and effort.

label.zh: 我们必须对此区域进行投资。
label.en: We must invest in this area.

label.zh: 我们有强大的团队，帮助他们复原。
label.en: We have a strong community, help them recover.

label.zh: 驱逐该地居民并将该片区域夷为平地。
label.en: Throw out the inhabitants and raze the area.
